title: An Explainable Coherence Score for Detecting Temporal Inconsistencies in Political News
abstract: arXiv:2608.29175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temporal inconsistencies, such as mandates attributed outside their real interval, events presented as past before they occurred, or inverted causal sequences, are a form of political disinformation that evades style-based fake news detectors: a well-written article with a single wrong date carries no lexical signal of falsehood. This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), a continuous, intrinsically interpretable metric that quantifies the temporal coherence of a news article, computed by a four-stage pipeline: extraction of temporal facts, construction of a temporal knowledge graph, hierarchical verification against internal consistency rules and external reference sources, and score aggregation with automatically generated explanations. Verification combines eight internal checkers derived from Allen's interval algebra with a five-level external hierarchy ranging from a locally stored reference knowledge base of 1{,}256

translated_title: 用于检测政治新闻中时间不一致性的可解释连贯性评分
translated_abstract: 时间不一致性，例如将授权归于其实际时间区间之外、在事件发生之前将其呈现为已发生、或颠倒的因果序列，是一种能够规避基于风格的假新闻检测器的政治虚假信息：一篇文笔流畅的文章，即使只含有一个错误的日期，也不会带有任何词汇层面的虚假信号。本文提出了时间连贯性评分，这是一种连续的、内在可解释的指标，用于量化新闻文章的时间连贯性。该评分通过一个四阶段流水线计算：时间事实抽取、时间知识图谱构建、针对内部一致性规则与外部参考来源的分层验证、以及带有自动生成解释的评分聚合。验证环节结合了源自Allen区间代数的八个内部检查器，以及一个五级外部参考层级体系，其范围从本地存储的包含1,256个（条目）的参考知识库开始……
tldr: 本文提出时间连贯性评分（TCS），一种内在可解释的连续指标，通过时间事实抽取、时间知识图谱构建、分层验证与评分聚合四阶段流水线，检测规避传统风格检测器、基于时间不一致性的政治虚假信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), an intrinsically interpretable continuous metric computed via a four-stage pipeline—temporal fact extraction, temporal knowledge graph construction, hierarchical verification, and score aggregation with generated explanations—to detect political disinformation based on temporal inconsistencies that evades style-based fake news detectors.
